name: Chlorophyll Dental Bones for Small Breeds
label: Mint, 60 g

texts.about_this_item: Zubochistiki mint dental bones with chlorophyll for small-breed dogs (7 pieces) — a multifunctional treat with health benefits. The chlorophyll improves feed digestibility, supports a healthy intestinal flora, helps eliminate toxins and strengthens the immune system.
texts.ingredient_information: Wheat protein, protein peptides, fibre, glycerin, sodium caseinate, monostearin, chlorophyll, brewer's yeast, magnesium stearate, essential oils, natural flavourings (mint).
texts.feeding_instructions: For dogs up to 10 kg — 1 treat per day.
